name: ESP32JTAG

programming.details: The on-board ESP32-S3 configures the iCE40UP5K over SPI, auto-loading the bitstream at boot; the board is managed through a WiFi web UI.

description: An ESP32-S3 all-in-one wireless hardware debug tool (JTAG/SWD debugger, logic analyzer, XVC server, signal generator) that also doubles as an iCE40UP5K FPGA dev board, with a WiFi web UI.
